rules.description: [Apple kbd] Window tiling: ctrl-option + Colemak h/i/e/n (+shift), f/c/r -> fn-ctrl tiling (physical keys; keep ABOVE Colemak Wide)
[Apple kbd] caps_lock -> control, escape if pressed alone
[Apple kbd] Vi Mode [A as Trigger Key]
[Apple kbd] Raise Key Mode [Space Bar as Trigger Key]
[Other kbd: QMK, mechanical] Window tiling: ctrl-option h/i/e/n (+shift), f/c/r -> fn-ctrl tiling
